title: Brand New G6 Sensor gives "Sensor Failed Start" Error
symptom: A brand new Dexcom G6 sensor fails to start in xDrip+, giving multiple 'Sensor Failed Start' errors during warmup. The transmitter is found and warmup begins, but then errors occur. The issue happens with a new sensor, not a restart.
cause: The G6 transmitter has a crude restart detection mechanism that can trigger even with a brand new sensor if the transmitter is not kept out of the sensor for at least 10 minutes before starting.
fix: After the old sensor has stopped, remove it and wait at least 10 minutes before snapping the transmitter into the new sensor. If already in a failed state, perform a restart as described in the linked guide.
evidence_quote: A G6 transmitter has a crude restart detection mechanism.  It can trigger even with a brand new sensor! To avoid it, make sure to keep the transmitter out of the sensor for at least 10 minutes before starting.
